description: This PHP source file is a module detail view for the 'Products' module in a vtiger CRM system. It initializes the environment, retrieves product data, and prepares variables for rendering the product detail view page with templates.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a CRM entity, used here to instantiate a product record.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class extended for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of CRMEntity for the current module.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks permissions or buttons related to the current module.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Retrieves the tab ID for the module.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Gets the parent tab information for the module.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data.

methods.name: session_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a session variable.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Fetches the display name of the entity.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Fetches update information for the record.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets sequence number field info for the module.

methods.name: getTaxDetailsForProduct
methods.description: Retrieves tax details associated with the product.

methods.name: getProductTaxPercentage
methods.description: Gets tax percentage for a given tax.

methods.name: getPriceDetailsForProduct
methods.description: Fetches price details for the product.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if related lists are present for module.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into structured arrays.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves validation data for database fields.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for viewing, editing, deleting.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves UI blocks for the module detail view.

methods.name: Vtiger_Link::getAllByType
methods.description: Gets custom links by type for the module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related lists for the module.

methods.name: RelatedListViewSession::addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to session data.

methods.name: RelatedListViewSession::getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves related modules stored in the session.

methods.name: VT_detailViewNavigation
methods.description: Handles record navigation in detail view.
